problem_type: Loss of classified generation failures and renderer retry amplification
symptom: The release radar reports 557 unknown reasons across versions and 27 image failures on one installation. Controlled repros show classified failures becoming unknown and deterministic terminal failures executing three times.
direct_cause: Task IPC drops the vendor category carried by an adapter cause. The Run substitutes a generic sentence for most terminal reasons. The renderer retry policy reads timeout-like prose even when structured evidence already closed the attempt.
class_root: Generation consumers discard or override the machine-readable failure facts owned by the adapter or Run, so later consumers infer a result or retry from diagnostic prose.
affected_population: Creators submitting image or video jobs from Workbench or Canvas, or reading a restored Run after an upstream terminal failure.
entry_points: Workbench and canvas use task IPC and the same generation outcome reporter. Canvas and catalog jobs share the Run journal.
Canvas single and batch execution now share the one-attempt boundary in the Step 2 contract.
internal_only_reason: The Step 1 invariant concerns internal IPC serialization, Run persistence and renderer retry decisions. The tests exercise application error types, persisted Run reads and telemetry with controlled provider inputs.
invariants: On a failed poll, persist the already-classified vendor category, status and safe code for the next Run reader.
Carry the classified provider facts across task IPC, including a transparent catalog adapter wrapper. Outer dispatch evidence retains priority.
A machine-classified terminal outcome yields one renderer executor invocation per intent.

door_reduction.why_not: IPC handlers and the browser prompt wrapper share one guard. Agent encoding, runtime, adapter and task polling keep distinct entry points that reuse wire helpers. The Run domain and observation code share the Run submission service, which adds one call to the disk-safe projection. Workbench and Canvas share one telemetry reporter. Canvas execution and failure display retain separate consumers of machine facts. Shared wire and Nomi tag readers retain their independent projection and recovery responsibilities.

generality_proof: Workbench and Canvas share task IPC and telemetry classification. Both production generation engines use the same Run poll and disk projection. Single and batch Canvas execution share the single-attempt run controller (Step 2).

shared_boundaries.responsibility: On a failed poll, persist the already-classified vendor category, status and safe code for the next Run reader.
Carry the classified provider facts across task IPC, including a transparent catalog adapter wrapper. Outer dispatch evidence retains priority.
Preserve safe structured category and codes for a failed Run observation.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Attaches the task failure guard to submission IPC.
Canvas and Workbench classify submit throws, immediate failures and failed polls through the same telemetry reporter.
Canvas and catalog engine terminal poll failures reach polledFailureMessage and are read from disk with their category.
Single image, single video and batch paths use the same one-attempt run controller; Step 2 owns this boundary.

recurrence.reason: Independent providers, IPC entry points, Run engines and renderer inputs can reach the same machine-classified failure boundaries.
same_class_scan: The door-map covers the IPC guard and wire helpers, Run poll and disk projection, renderer retry and telemetry classification.
Checked direct and wrapped IPC errors, both Workbench and Canvas submit and poll outcomes, both Run engines, and single and batch Canvas execution.

prevention.invariant: Known failure facts survive IPC and Run persistence, and a classified terminal outcome ends the renderer retry loop.
prevention.failure_mode: Use the shared classifier for evidence provided by IPC or a persisted Run. Preserve genuine unknowns when facts are absent, and end automatic renderer retries when terminal classification is present.
prevention.strategy: Reuse the wire encoding in the task IPC guard and project poll facts through the disk-safe Run boundary. Step 2 removed renderer retries entirely.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaced top-level-only IPC classification, the lossy default Run failure projection and text-first retry for structured terminal errors.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The existing IPC serialization and Run persistence APIs already carry the required facts.

migration: Existing events and old Run rows with erased categories cannot recover them. New failures use the existing wire and Run formats.
residual_risks: Aggregate counts have no run identity or click provenance. Historical event-cause attribution and paid provider results are unverified.
Step 2 supersedes the renderer retry predicate and implements the approved reference and dispatch-status rules; see 2026-11-24-fa-step2-rw1-rw2-rw3.
